zhao_dextran_exchange.locator: Methods on solution exchange and supporting Figure S3a–c
zhao_dextran_exchange.preparation: Trapped giant unilamellar vesicles containing fluorescent dextran. The incoming solution contained the unlabelled polymers.
zhao_dextran_exchange.uncertainty: Error bars in S3c are SD. Some vesicles were lost. The fraction of internal tracer retained in the surviving vesicles was unreported.

sumi_intervesicle_transfer.preparation: DOPC donor and acceptor liposomes with fluorescent C6-NBD-PC tracer in the donor preparation.
sumi_intervesicle_transfer.uncertainty: Representative trace. The paper gives no interval for the crossover and measures fluorescence across populations.
